title: Prepaid meal unavailable after airline rebooking
facts_text: I prepaid EUR 25 for a meal on my Northstar Air flight. The airline rebooked me onto another flight. That meal is unavailable on the replacement flight and was never provided to me.
request: Please refund the EUR 25 prepaid meal charge.
adaptation_note: The unprovided-meal concept is source-inspired. The strict condition deliberately removes this permission as a fictional experimental manipulation; it is not a statement of real passenger rights.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses.

policy_variants.strict: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. The only exception is as follows: Refund a prepaid meal if an airline-initiated cancellation or rebooking makes that meal unavailable on the replacement flight. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Refunds for extra options
records.access_method: Official Netherlands English page text retrieved
records.observations: Extra-baggage refunds can be requested within 24 hours of purchase or after rebooking to a non-KLM-operated flight. A paid meal unavailable after qualifying cancellation or rebooking can also support a refund request.
